description: Authorize a payment action against the active Fidacy mandate. Returns an ALLOW with a signed grant, or a DENY with the violated rule. The downstream executor MUST require the grant. Call this before any payment; never pay without it.

category.description: Purpose category (must be allowed by the mandate)

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Your own key for this payment, if you have one (an order id, a job id). Leave it out and Fidacy derives one from the payment itself, which is the safer default: a retry of the SAME payment produces the SAME key, where an invented one would not.

invoiceRef.description: Optional invoice identity. When set, Fidacy enforces one payment per invoice: a second request for the same invoiceRef is DENIED, at any amount.

purpose.description: Your stated reason for this payment, in your own words. It is persisted readably on the tamper-evident audit record (ALLOW and DENY alike) and becomes part of the after-the-fact proof, so write the real reason.

name: request_payment
title: Request Payment Authorization
